infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: ShootSpot uses the camera to photograph locations you scout.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: ShootSpot uses your location to pin the place you photograph and to show locations near you. You can always place the pin manually instead.
